title: Listening Section 2 - Welcome to the Sports Centre
instruction: You will hear the manager of a community sports centre welcoming new members. Answer Questions 1-10.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to Greenfield Sports Centre. I'm Karen, the manager. I'd like to tell you about our facilities and a few rules before you start using them.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: The centre opened in two thousand and eighteen, so it's still quite new. Our pool is twenty-five metres long. Some of you may have expected a bigger one, but it's ideal for lane swimming and family sessions. The pool is closed for cleaning every Wednesday. Many other centres close on Mondays, but we don't.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: If you want to use the gym, you must first attend an induction. It lasts forty-five minutes and it's free for members. You can book it at reception or through our app. The app is also how you book exercise classes, so please download it today.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: We have a climbing wall, which is very popular with families. Children must be at least eight years old to use it, and anyone under sixteen must be accompanied by an adult. This year we have also added a sauna next to the changing rooms. It's open to adults only.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: The class timetable changes every month. You'll find the latest version on our website, and printed copies are not available any more, to save paper. The notice board by the entrance is only for announcements.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: A few practical points. Lockers need a refundable coin, which you'll get back when you open the locker. The car park is free for members, but it closes at ten o'clock in the evening. If you leave your car later than that, you won't be able to get it out until the morning.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Finally, please look after your membership card. If you lose it, you can get a replacement at reception for five pounds. You don't need to phone me or send an email. Just come to the desk.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: That's all from me. Enjoy the centre, and please ask any member of staff if you need help.
